name: Cable Face Pull
steps: Attach a rope to a cable set near eye level and grip one end in each hand with thumbs pointing back.
Step back into a staggered or athletic stance until the cable is taut with your arms extended forward.
Pull the rope toward your face while driving your elbows wide and rotating your hands beside your ears.
Pause briefly with your shoulder blades squeezed, then extend your arms forward under control.
tips: Keep your head still and your wrists aligned with your forearms.
Let the rope ends separate beside your temples while keeping your ribs over your hips.
